title: Conditional downstream calcium-response reconstruction after identified-neuron perturbation
scientific_question: Does a stimulated neuron’s measured calcium response improve prediction of a receiver’s complete measured post-stimulation trace in held worms beyond receiver prehistory and train-only pair/condition means?
participant_inputs: For each experimentally observed source→receiver pair/trial, source calcium from−10to+30seconds, receiver calcium from−10to0, actual timestamps, verified neuron identities and stimulus timing/parameters. Include only information established independently of the withheld receiver response. Source post-stimulus input makes this retrospective conditional prediction, not forecasting before stimulation.
known_answer: Receiver fluorescence/time series from0to30seconds in the same trial, hidden in evaluator custody. This is an observed-response target, not a binary ground truth for direct synapses or mechanism.
complete_scope: All acquisitions and measured receiver/source pairs in the declared immutable release, including weak/nonresponding pairs and failed/self-response trials with explicit quality/coverage flags. This is a new release-level task, not whole-paper reproduction. The release's genotype/condition coverage must be reconciled against OSF; missing mutant or spontaneous cohorts cannot silently be claimed included.
protected_split: All recordings of one authenticated worm held together; session IDs/NWB subjects first joined to original acquisition and animal identities. If the same animal cannot be resolved, no between-animal result. Train-only pair kernels or mean responses exclude the held worm; neuron identities can recur across worms.
input_representation: All original time samples in each declared source/receiver window, with channel IDs, exact timestamps and explicit missingness. Each case is a genuine measured pair/trial, not a new benchmark. The complete case roster retains all receiver neurons; no significance selection or top-responsive-cell compression. Trace-only extraction must retain all declared measurements and metadata from the original release, with checksum/source-index joins; no fitted kernel/atlas substitute. If30s tails are unavailable, preserve explicit missing-time coverage and resolve one common supported horizon from development metadata before freeze.

scoring.primary: Receiver response MSE relative to training-only pair-mean predictor, aggregated over valid samples then trials/pairs within authenticated worm; compare per-worm paired error. Raw error and training-variance normalized error both reported.
scoring.secondary: Correlation and response-area error, with zero-variance cases explicitly handled; target variance or normalizing range from held response is evaluator-only and never agent-visible.
scoring.uncertainty: Worm-level paired intervals after identity verification, not pair/trial pseudo-replication.

comparators: Receiver pre-stimulus persistence/flat baseline, training-only source→receiver mean trajectory, and training-only linear convolution kernel fitted with regularization chosen on separate development worms. Author atlas kernels fitted using the full release are disallowed as clean held-out baselines; a declared exposed specialist is only an auxiliary condition.
negative_controls: Source traces reassigned across matched stimulations within animal/condition, preserving autocorrelation and missingness.
Target-neuron identity permutation, synchronization shifts and all-failure coverage audits.
leakage_controls: Published pooled kernels/response significance include prospective test animals.
Automated target assignment and ROI order can be wrong; independent acquisition→trace→identity alignment is a required gate.
Light artifact, adjacent-cell stimulation, source autoreponse and overall calcium state may explain gain.
Quality masks chosen from target effect size, target-side normalization and hidden spontaneous/mutant cohort mixing can leak.

These metadata counts do not prove113 independent animals or trace availability for every acquisition.

resources: Full immutable DANDI release is4.07TB, not a laptop-scale download. A scientifically complete trace-only acquisition may be far smaller, but full trace-file/array manifest and exact total are UNESTABLISHED. Do not download imaging merely to meet count goals or choose a small convenient animal subset. Propose source-only inventory next; after verification, stream traces and fit CPU kernels with8–32GB RAM, hours estimated; no GPU scientifically required.

paired_access_conditions.direct: No-tools inference on the complete canonical signal packet and target-free permitted context.
paired_access_conditions.numerical: Numerical tools on the identical packet. Frozen-program versus per-case adaptive tool use is separately logged within this task.
paired_access_conditions.specialist: Audited fixed feature extractor or train-only physiological model on identical information; trained model access is an assistance condition, not evidence of unaided understanding.
paired_access_conditions.parity: Same case IDs, inputs, units, masks, training/calibration exposure, protected answers, and transform support. Raw versus lossy derived signals are separately labelled input substrates; no equivalence assumed. Richer-input specialists are auxiliary.
paired_access_conditions.interpretation: Association, tool use, public exposure and physiological understanding remain separate. No model campaign is selected.

machine_output.predictions: Complete receiver calcium trace on authenticated0..30s poststimulus grid for every declared trial/source-receiver pair, with cases keyed by authentic worm/acquisition/genotype and pair.
machine_output.score_rows: Per-worm full-support MSE and difference from train-only pair-mean prediction; variance-normalized evaluation secondary, not a target-derived input. Every weak/nonresponse and unsupported pair retained.
machine_output.coverage: All acquisitions/pairs/conditions in declared release and complementary source scope;113metadata subjects are not assumed independent worms.

distinctness: Conditional response propagation from controlled neural stimulation, distinct from existing Flavell locomotor-turn decoding and history analyses.
stronger_claim_hold: Source input includes−10..+30s calcium while receiver context stops at0; this is retrospective conditional inference, not pre-stimulus forecasting or proof of direct synaptic connectivity.

publication_context.historical_administrative_text: Proposal-era counts, recommendations and source-phase observations in inherited fields are historical. The package registry records the applied 233-draft programme state; no authentic readiness is inferred.
publication_context.private_locator_policy: Null path fields identify private construction evidence that is not shipped or dereferenced. Original byte/hash pins are provenance references, not public validation certificates or dependency availability.

primary_outputs: Receiver’s original measured fluorescence samples from 0 through 30 seconds relative to stimulation, with acquisition missingness retained; these measurements define prediction error, not a binary direct-synapse label.
biological_unit: Authenticated worm; all acquisitions and sessions from that worm stay in one role. DANDI’s 113 subject labels can be acquisition dates and are not 113 established animals.
case_definition: One actual stimulation trial and source-to-receiver pair, retaining every original target timestamp and weak/nonresponse case.

inputs: Source calcium at all original timestamps in [-10,30] s; receiver prehistory in [-10,0) s, with missing values retained.

Verified source/receiver identity, condition, stimulus duration/power and native onset; train-role target traces only. Requested held response_times_s are public, while held values and masks stay private.
forbidden_inputs: Held/development receiver responses, target-derived normalization, response-significance masks, quality flags or arbitrary evaluator metadata.
Published full-release pair kernels/significance summaries that include held worms, or stimulus metadata silently copied from unverified converter constants.
allowed_inputs.case_identity: Implemented normalized cases require case_id, worm_id, acquisition_id, trial_id, source_id, receiver_id and condition plus source asset/hash/ROI indices in custody. Public exports retain the identity fields and onset; an opaque target-safe alias map and exposure review remain necessary for protected participant use. Supplied identity_authenticated=true is an assertion, not an independent identity audit.
allowed_inputs.split: Implemented train/development/held roles require every worm in exactly one role and each acquisition in one worm. Kernel regularization is selected on separate development worms, with no refit of their responses into training. Authentic role assignment and full source identity map are not delivered.
allowed_inputs.coverage: Frozen expected_case_ids must exactly match all selected measured pairs/trials, including failures and weak/nonresponse records. Immutable release has 113 imaging and 110 segmentation assets; sub-20, sub-23 and sub-33 lack segmentation partners. Complete trace-only acquisition, OSF/genotype/spontaneous coverage and authentic worm census remain unresolved.

direct_observation.representation: Possible complete numeric source/receiver-prehistory trace case with original timestamps and missingness.
direct_observation.boundary: No tools or receiver target values; source post-stimulus context is openly retrospective. Numeric export exists but no direct model transport or complete answer collector.
missing: Direct response protocol and proven complete-case context/coverage delivery.

typed_viewer.representation: Potential typed dual-trace display of source response and receiver prehistory on native time axes.
typed_viewer.boundary: No target trace, target mask, pooled kernel or response-selected overview; any interpolation must be declared and must not replace raw samples.
missing: No typed trace viewer or image-only participant path is implemented.

tool_assisted.representation: Numerical per-case conditional response investigation using the exported trace schema and allowed train-role data.
tool_assisted.boundary: Same tools/checkpoints/input/compute within comparisons; no held/development score feedback; source export is available but adaptive execution is not enforced.
missing: Protected per-case numerical agent runtime, identity sanitization, tool logs and resource accounting.

frozen_program.representation: Precommitted response-prediction code with training-only fit and fixed calibration/normalization.
frozen_program.boundary: Existing evaluator consumes predictions but does not bind their generating programme or train exposure. Freeze before held-worm access and preserve exact original time grids.
missing: Participant programme lifecycle, artifact provenance and authentic full-roster inference execution.

primary.name: Complete-held-worm mean candidate MSE minus train-only pair-mean MSE
primary.aggregation: Mean squared error over observed original samples per case; equal trials within condition/source/receiver pair; equal pairs within worm; equal held worms. Report every worm’s paired effect. A missing paired metric in any observed case suppresses the complete-roster mean and interval.
primary.rationale: Tests incremental conditional neural prediction beyond repeatable pair identity/stimulus structure without treating correlated pairs/trials as independent animals.

secondary: Raw model, pair-mean, receiver-persistence and convolution MSE; training-variance-normalized MSE and paired differences, undefined for missing/zero training variance.
Pearson correlation with explicit constant-trace outcomes.
Signed/absolute response-area error on adjacent valid samples within declared gap, with integrated duration and missing-tail coverage.

comparators.name: Training-only pair/condition mean
comparators.inputs: Training worms’ receiver traces for matching condition/source/receiver identity.
comparators.procedure: Implemented original-time interpolation only within supported adjacent samples and fixed max gap; average trials within worm then worms. Unseen/unsupported pairs retain undefined predictions instead of a favorable subset.

comparators.name: Receiver prehistory persistence
comparators.procedure: Implemented mean of valid prestimulus values predicts a flat poststimulus trace; no target centering.

comparators.name: Regularized source convolution
comparators.inputs: Same source trace and receiver prehistory; train-role targets.
comparators.procedure: Implemented prospective trapezoid lag grid [0,1,2,4] s and ridge grid [0.01,0.1,1], equal-worm fit, separate development selection without refit. These are new benchmark references, not reproduced author exponential kernels.

nuisance_controls: Implemented whole-source reassignment within animal/condition/source/stimulus/exact-clock groups; all receivers of one trial share the reassignment and unmatched singletons remain visible.
Stimulus/identity-only pair means and receiver-prehistory-only persistence; still require authentic identity permutation and synchronization-shift controls.
Check light artifacts, adjacent-cell stimulation and global calcium state; protect masks from effect-size selection.
Reconcile converter date-derived subject IDs, hardcoded WT, duration/power constants and zero/nonpositive ROI mapping against original acquisition records.
evaluation.uncertainty: Implemented prospective paired whole-worm percentile bootstrap: 2,000 draws, seed 0, 95% interval; fewer than two supported worms or incomplete paired support yields no complete-roster interval. Actual animal count/dependence and inferential adequacy require authentic identity review.
evaluation.failure_policy: Every held case and exact original target grid must appear once, with finite predictions even at missing-target positions and correct units. Missing/extra/duplicate/grid-invalid predictions fail. All-missing targets, unsupported references, absent tails and quality flags remain explicit; no favorable intersection or shorter horizon is substituted.
